query: What exact, reproducible search strings and field filters should we use for Scopus and WoS to capture outputs from private East Java universities (including date range and document types)?

response.query: What exact, reproducible search strings and field filters should we use for Scopus and WoS to capture outputs from private East Java universities (including date range and document types)?
response.answer: For Scopus: "institution.name.(Indonesia AND (private AND East Java)) AND PUBYEAR > 2018 AND PUBYEAR < 2026 AND (DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'ar' OR DOCUMENT_TYPE ='re' OR DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'rv')". For WoS: "AFFILIATION (Indonesia AND (private AND East Java)) AND YEAR > 2018 AND YEAR < 2026 AND (DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'AR' OR DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'RA' OR DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'RV')".

results.title: A Review on Telecommunications and AI Technologies ...
results.content: The increasing integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education (AIEd) and its dependence on contemporary communication infrastructures (5G/6G, the Internet of Things (IoT), and Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC)) has prompted a surge of research into applications, infrastructural dependencies, and deployment constraints. This review synthesises the recent literature (2022–2025) to examine how telecommunications and AI technologies converge to enhance educational ecosystems through adaptive learning systems, intelligent tutoring systems, AI-driven assessment, and administration. artificial intelligence in education; telecommunications; adaptive learning systems; personalised learning; 5G/6G; IoT; AI-driven assessment tools; ethical AI; AI This review also connects research work from the educational sector to the telecommunications engineering field and explains the crucial role played by the architecture of 5G/6G communication networks and edge computing in the efficient application of AI in the educational sector through the establishment of an IoT backbone.
